meta.title: What Did You Do in the Holiday?
meta.textType: story: friends tell what they did, in order

paragraphs: Monday, January fourth, was the first school day of the new year. Before the lesson, Teacher Kim drew a long line on the board. She wrote the days of the holiday under the line, from Thursday to Sunday. Lily, Mia, Leo, and May sat at their desks. They were excited to see each other. "Good morning, everybody," said Teacher Kim. "What did you do in the holiday?" Each child had a story to tell, but there was not much time.

Leo put up his hand first. "I went to a campsite by a lake with my uncle," he said. "First we put up a tent, and then we cooked rice on a fire." "In the evening, we counted the stars." "I enjoy camping, and I am good at making a fire," said Leo. He held his arms wide to show the size of the fire. "It was this big!" Mia and May laughed, and Teacher Kim smiled.

Then May told her story. "I stayed in a hotel by the sea for two nights," she said. "We visited the beach every morning, and I found a few shells." "I enjoyed swimming, because the sea was warm." Teacher Kim looked at the clock. "We have only a few minutes," she said. "Please draw your days on the line." Lily took a green marker and went to the board. She drew a small house under Saturday. "I took my suitcase to Green Hill with Tom," she said. Mia, Leo, and May sat at the front. Teacher Kim held the eraser.

"It was a short journey, only one hour by bus," said Lily. "Grandma and Grandpa waited for us at the bus stop." Then Mia stood up. "I stayed at home with Snow, my white kitten," she said. "My holiday was not exciting, but I liked it anyway." "It was a relaxing holiday, and I slept a lot." Leo drew a tent, May drew a hotel, and Mia drew a cat.

Teacher Kim looked at the whole board and smiled. "A tent, a hotel, a house, and a cat," she said. "Which day did you like best?" "I liked Green Hill best, because Grandma cooked all day," said Lily. "Now we have come back to school," said Teacher Kim. "We have a lot of new stories." "Please remember to write three lines for the blog by Thursday." Lily smiled, because she liked the stories of her friends. Lily thought about her wonderful holiday at Green Hill.
text.summary: On the first school day of the new year, Teacher Kim asks the children what they did in the holiday. Leo, May, Lily, and Mia tell their stories, and Lily draws her day on the board.
